# Memory Panel

## Summary
A settings panel listing what the assistant remembers about the user, where each memory can be edited or forgotten, with a master switch for memory and a "Forget all". A matching one-line notice in the chat tells the user when something new is saved. Together they make personalisation visible and reversible.

## When to use
- Assistants that save facts about the user across conversations (role, preferences, projects) and use them in later answers.
- Products where personalisation could surprise people — they should be able to see why an answer assumed something.
- Anywhere data-protection rules give users the right to see and delete what is stored about them.

## When not to use
- Context that only lives within one conversation — that is the chat history, not memory.
- Organisation-level knowledge (docs, connectors). Use Connector Panel for sources the AI can read.
- As the only control. Pair it with a temporary-chat option (Incognito Toggle) so people can avoid saving in the first place.

## Anatomy
- Header: title, a one-line explanation that changes when memory is off, and a master switch.
- Memory rows: the memory in plain language, an optional source line ("From a chat on 12 Oct"), and edit and forget actions.
- Inline editor: a textarea replacing the row, with Save and Cancel.
- Empty state: what memory is for and how to add one.
- Footer: a count, an Undo affordance after a deletion, and a two-step "Forget all".
- Memory-updated notice: a pill in the chat ("Memory updated · …") with a Manage link to the panel.

## Behavior
- Forgetting a memory removes it at once and shows Undo for a few seconds; the deletion is committed when that window passes. Forgetting another memory commits the previous one first.
- "Forget all" asks for a second click and resets if focus leaves the button.
- Turning memory off keeps saved memories but stops saving and using them; the list dims and the header explains this. Turning it back on restores them.
- Editing saves on Enter or Save, cancels on Escape; an empty edit is discarded.
- The notice appears in the conversation at the moment a memory is saved, never silently.

## Content guidelines
- Write memories as short, third-person facts: "Prefers concise answers", not "The user has mentioned that they would like…".
- Say where each memory came from, so users can tell inferred facts from ones they asked for.
- Use "Forget" rather than "Delete" — it describes the effect on the assistant.

## Accessibility
- The master switch is a `role="switch"` with an accessible name.
- Edit and forget buttons name the memory they act on; they stay visible on touch and on keyboard focus, and only hide on hover-capable screens.
- Undo and the memory-updated notice are `role="status"` so screen readers announce them.
- The inline editor takes focus when opened; Escape cancels without saving.

## Related patterns
- Incognito Toggle is the up-front control: it stops memories being saved for one chat, where this panel manages them afterwards.
- Connector Panel governs which external sources the AI can read; this panel governs what it has learned about the user.
- Tool Approval asks before an action runs; memory saves are low-risk enough to happen inline, then be reversed here.

## Default implementation (Tailwind v4 + Radix + Motion)

This is the catalogue's own reference implementation — use it verbatim when the
host project has no established design system, or when the user asks for
"the demoed look." When the host project has its own design system, treat
this code as a translation reference: keep every rule from the spec above
(Anatomy, Behavior, Content guidelines, Accessibility) and re-express the
markup, styling, and motion using that system's own components/tokens
instead of copying these Tailwind classes or the Motion API.

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from "motion/react";
import { Brain, Check, Pencil, Trash2, X } from "lucide-react";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export interface Memory {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  /** Where it was learned, already formatted ("From a chat on 12 Oct"). */
  source?: string;
}

export interface MemoryPanelProps {
  memories: Memory[];
  /** Whether the AI may save and use memories at all. */
  enabled: boolean;
  onEnabledChange: (enabled: boolean) => void;
  onEdit?: (id: string, text: string) => void;
  /** Called once the undo window has passed, so the deletion can be committed. */
  onDelete?: (id: string) => void;
  onClearAll?: () => void;
  title?: string;
  /** How long a deleted memory can be restored, in ms. */
  undoMs?: number;
  className?: string;
}

export function MemoryPanel({
  memories,
  enabled,
  onEnabledChange,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
  onClearAll,
  title = "Memory",
  undoMs = 5000,
  className,
}: MemoryPanelProps) {
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [draft, setDraft] = React.useState("");
  const [pending, setPending] = React.useState<Memory | null>(null);
  const [confirmClear, setConfirmClear] = React.useState(false);
  const timer = React.useRef<number | undefined>(undefined);
  const onDeleteRef = React.useRef(onDelete);
  const titleId = React.useId();

  React.useEffect(() => {
    onDeleteRef.current = onDelete;
  }, [onDelete]);

  React.useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(timer.current), []);

  const visible = memories.filter((m) => m.id !== pending?.id);

  function commitPending() {
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current);
    if (pending) onDeleteRef.current?.(pending.id);
  }

  function remove(memory: Memory) {
    // Deleting another memory commits the previous one first: one undo at a time.
    commitPending();
    setPending(memory);
    timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      onDeleteRef.current?.(memory.id);
      setPending(null);
    }, undoMs);
  }

  function undo() {
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current);
    setPending(null);
  }

  function startEdit(memory: Memory) {
    setEditingId(memory.id);
    setDraft(memory.text);
  }

  function saveEdit() {
    const text = draft.trim();
    if (editingId && text) onEdit?.(editingId, text);
    setEditingId(null);
  }

  return (
    <section
      aria-labelledby={titleId}
      className={cn("flex w-full flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border bg-card", className)}
    >
      <header className="flex items-start gap-3 border-b px-4 py-3">
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <h3 id={titleId} className="text-sm font-semibold">
            {title}
          </h3>
          <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-pretty text-muted-foreground">
            {enabled
              ? "Details the assistant remembers about you to personalise answers."
              : "Memory is off. Nothing new is saved, and saved memories aren't used."}
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          role="switch"
          aria-checked={enabled}
          aria-label="Use memory"
          onClick={() => onEnabledChange(!enabled)}
          className={cn(
            "relative mt-0.5 inline-flex h-5 w-9 shrink-0 items-center rounded-full transition-colors",
            enabled ? "bg-foreground" : "bg-muted-foreground/30"
          )}
        >
          <motion.span
            layout
            transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 500, damping: 32 }}
            className={cn("size-4 rounded-full bg-background shadow-sm", enabled ? "ml-[18px]" : "ml-0.5")}
          />
        </button>
      </header>

      <ul className={cn("flex flex-col transition-opacity", !enabled && "opacity-50")} aria-label="Saved memories">
        <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
          {visible.map((memory) => (
            <motion.li
              key={memory.id}
              layout
              initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, height: "auto" }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.2, ease: "easeOut" }}
              className="group overflow-hidden border-b last:border-b-0"
            >
              {editingId === memory.id ? (
                <form
                  className="flex flex-col gap-2 px-4 py-3"
                  onSubmit={(e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    saveEdit();
                  }}
                >
                  <textarea
                    autoFocus
                    value={draft}
                    onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)}
                    onKeyDown={(e) => {
                      if (e.key === "Escape") setEditingId(null);
                      if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        saveEdit();
                      }
                    }}
                    aria-label="Edit memory"
                    rows={2}
                    className="w-full resize-none rounded-lg border bg-background px-2.5 py-1.5 text-sm outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
                  />
                  <div className="flex justify-end gap-1.5">
                    <IconButton label="Cancel" onClick={() => setEditingId(null)}>
                      <X className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />
                    </IconButton>
                    <IconButton label="Save" type="submit" primary>
                      <Check className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />
                    </IconButton>
                  </div>
                </form>
              ) : (
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3 px-4 py-3">
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <p className="text-sm text-pretty">{memory.text}</p>
                    {memory.source && <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{memory.source}</p>}
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex shrink-0 gap-0.5 opacity-100 transition-opacity [@media(hover:hover)]:opacity-0 [@media(hover:hover)]:group-hover:opacity-100 [@media(hover:hover)]:focus-within:opacity-100">
                    {onEdit && (
                      <IconButton label={`Edit memory: ${memory.text}`} onClick={() => startEdit(memory)}>
                        <Pencil className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />
                      </IconButton>
                    )}
                    <IconButton label={`Forget: ${memory.text}`} onClick={() => remove(memory)}>
                      <Trash2 className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />
                    </IconButton>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </motion.li>
          ))}
        </AnimatePresence>

        {visible.length === 0 && (
          <li className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1 px-4 py-8 text-center">
            <Brain className="size-5 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden />
            <p className="text-sm font-medium">Nothing remembered yet</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Ask the assistant to remember something, like your role or tone.</p>
          </li>
        )}
      </ul>

      <footer className="flex min-h-11 items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t bg-muted/40 px-4 py-2">
        <AnimatePresence mode="wait" initial={false}>
          {pending ? (
            <motion.div
              key="undo"
              role="status"
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 4 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -4 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.15 }}
              className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-3"
            >
              <span className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">Memory forgotten</span>
              <button type="button" onClick={undo} className="shrink-0 text-xs font-medium underline-offset-2 hover:underline">
                Undo
              </button>
            </motion.div>
          ) : (
            <motion.span
              key="count"
              initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
              className="text-xs text-muted-foreground"
            >
              {visible.length} {visible.length === 1 ? "memory" : "memories"}
            </motion.span>
          )}
        </AnimatePresence>

        {onClearAll && visible.length > 0 && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              if (!confirmClear) return setConfirmClear(true);
              setConfirmClear(false);
              commitPending();
              setPending(null);
              onClearAll();
            }}
            onBlur={() => setConfirmClear(false)}
            className={cn(
              "shrink-0 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium transition-colors",
              confirmClear ? "bg-destructive text-white" : "text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground"
            )}
          >
            {confirmClear ? "Click again to forget all" : "Forget all"}
          </button>
        )}
      </footer>
    </section>
  );
}

/** A one-line notice for the chat, shown when the assistant saves something new. */
export function MemoryUpdatedNotice({
  text,
  onManage,
  className,
}: {
  text: string;
  onManage?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 4 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.2, ease: "easeOut" }}
      role="status"
      className={cn("inline-flex max-w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-full border bg-muted/50 py-1 pr-1 pl-2.5 text-xs", className)}
    >
      <Brain className="size-3.5 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden />
      <span className="min-w-0 truncate">
        <span className="text-muted-foreground">Memory updated · </span>
        {text}
      </span>
      {onManage && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onManage}
          className="shrink-0 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 font-medium text-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-accent"
        >
          Manage
        </button>
      )}
    </motion.div>
  );
}

function IconButton({
  label,
  children,
  onClick,
  type = "button",
  primary,
}: {
  label: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  onClick?: () => void;
  type?: "button" | "submit";
  primary?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      type={type}
      onClick={onClick}
      aria-label={label}
      title={label.split(":")[0]}
      className={cn(
        "flex size-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md transition-colors",
        primary ? "bg-foreground text-background hover:bg-foreground/90" : "text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground"
      )}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}
```
